cohort: The study included 191 pregnant women, 90% of whom were nulliparous, attending Parenting and Childbirth Classes.
finding: 75% of participants reported low to moderate tokophobia, 25% exhibited high or very high fear, and pathological fear occurred in 1.6%, with fear of episiotomy, lack of control, and pain being the most significant factors.
mod_finding: An association exists between a preferred elective cesarean birth and tokophobia.
cross-section timing: Data was collected between June 2014 and September 2014, during pregnancy.
